resources.string: A filterless music player app
I loved the sound quality of the Mac's `afplay` command and wanted to carry it with me. I implemented the audio playback by directly tapping into the CoreAudio API.
Digital clock app
What is the date today
App to display the current date
When filling out medical questionnaires at hospitals, it was too much of a hassle to check the Gregorian year, Japanese era, month, date, and day of the week separately.
How old am I
App to calculate age from birthdate
When filling out medical questionnaires at hospitals, I could never remember my exact age and calculating it from my birthdate every time was a hassle.
App to remove metadata from images

I thought it would be reassuring to be able to remove location data myself before posting photos to social media. Developed as a team project during a group exercise in vocational school; I was mainly responsible for the ideation and PWA implementation.
Get random int
App to generate random numbers within a specified range
When setting up a server, randomizing the port number is better for security, but thinking of one every time was annoying. So I made an app to generate one quickly.
App that adds dakuten (voicing marks) to all entered characters
App that endlessly repeats entered text
Workaround to display YouTube Music links as cards on X (Twitter)
Web service to streamline sharing "Delicious!" information
Password Generator
Simple password generator supporting Hiragana and Katakana

Some services don't allow English alphabets in "Secret Questions", and answering them honestly is bad for security. Coming up with random strings (Hiragana/Katakana) myself every time was tedious, so I made it a tool.
NOT Pulling Probability Calculator
App to calculate the probability of never pulling the desired item

Created out of spite and momentum after experiencing the ~10% probability event of missing a 0.75% drop rate 300 times in a row to hit the "pity" system—3 times out of 4. For the record, I have now hit pity 4 times out of 8, making it an effective 1/2 probability for me.
App to convert text to L33t speak
Barometer
App to display atmospheric pressure sensor values
I wondered if atmospheric pressure changes were causing my poor health, and naturally wanted to see the raw values from my smartphone's built-in barometer sensor.
Code Scanner
Simple code scanner app
Created out of pure curiosity to scan QR codes on the street and see exactly what kind of data (string content) was embedded in them.
A simple macOS utility to switch input sources using custom keyboard shortcuts.

Using a US layout keyboard, the default input switching shortcuts conflicted with terminal operations in Android Studio, which was very annoying. I figured if Android Studio can hook keyboard inputs, I could build something to do it too.
A command-line tool to manage pocket money and cash on hand.
When I started living alone as a vocational school student, I wanted to accurately track exactly how much "pocket money" I had left after deducting living expenses.
Docker container that launches Neovim with plugins pre-installed.
I wanted to be able to instantly use my fully customized Neovim environment anywhere, such as on the PC at my part-time job.
Shell script to easily launch myDE.
Typing the command to launch the `myDE` Docker container every time was annoying, so I made a script to launch it easily.
Shell script to batch create directories and files with a specified name.
When creating shell scripts, making directories and files with the same name every single time was a hassle, so I made it doable in one command.
Shell script to copy a specified file to ~/myCommands/ and grant execution permissions.
After writing a custom shell script, copying it to a directory in my PATH and adding execution permissions every time was annoying, so I made it installable with one command.
Shell script that bundles the necessary steps to generate a jar file.
In my Java class at vocational school, typing the same boilerplate commands repeatedly to generate an executable jar file was a hassle, so I scripted and automated it on the spot.
A rubber duck written in Go.
CLI tool to collect licenses of third-party libraries in a Node.js project and export them in JSON format.

For my own library (`ngx-mat-third-party-licenses-list-view`), how license info is collected and outputted is a core feature. I didn't want to rely on or be broken by spec changes in other people's tools, so I built my own.
Converts HTML to PDF using Chromium.

When I was using Gemini on my Android phone to generate an HTML/CSS business card, it was annoying to have to pull out my PC just to convert it to a PDF. I built this via Gemini CLI in Termux to complete the entire process on my phone.
Gradle plugin to turn Compose Multiplatform Web apps into PWAs.
When building PWAs with Compose Multiplatform, copy-pasting the necessary files and configurations for every new project was too much of a hassle.
Neovim plugin to insert a \";\" at the end of the line.

In languages like Rust that require trailing semicolons, manually moving the cursor to the end of the line just to type a semicolon was a pain. I created a plugin that inserts a semicolon at the end of the line while maintaining the current cursor position.
Component library for Angular Material that provides a list of third-party licenses.

Displaying open-source licenses is mandatory for modern apps, but Angular's standard feature (`thirdpartylicenses.txt`) couldn't be referenced in SSR environments. Copy-pasting the implementation for every new app or updating all apps whenever a fix was needed was a huge pain, so I turned it into a library.
A simple app bar for Angular Material.
When building Web apps with Angular, making the same app bar (header) every time was a hassle, so I built it once and turned it into a library for reuse.
This library is a theme of little diva.
Since I'm building apps anyway, I want to add some unique flavor, but configuring or copy-pasting it for every single app was way too tedious, so I extracted the theme itself as a library.
Android library to achieve simultaneous execution of permission requests and processing.
Library for Android and Compose Multiplatform providing a function to create typography from font names or FontFamily.

When using Google Fonts in Android apps, copy-pasting the keys from the official documentation every time was a hassle. Also, writing the logic to override default font sizes for each app was too tedious to do manually, so I made it a reusable library.
A simple TopAppBar for Android and Compose Multiplatform containing a back button and a kebab menu button.
My personal simple app bar. Writing the same UI code for every app I made was annoying, so I commonized it as a component.
Template for making business cards with HTML and CSS.

Learning how to use a design tool I don't normally use just to make a business card was a bad investment of time and effort. I tried building it with my familiar HTML and CSS (since CSS allows millimeter-precision sizing) and it worked great, so I turned it into a template for next time.
